line.name: Joya de Nicaragua Rosalones Reserva
line.background_text: Rosalones Reserva is the fuller-bodied, all-Nicaraguan-leaf counterpart within the Rosalones family, wrapped in Nicaraguan Habano Criollo Colorado versus the Connecticut-seed wrapper of standard Rosalones (CT). It made its first official U.S. market debut alongside Rosalones CT in 2026, sold as a genuinely separate blend rather than a packaging variant. An earlier/international 'Rosalones Reserva' (vitola codes R546, R650, RR444) has also circulated via European retailers with a Nicaraguan Habano wrapper, consistent in character with the 2026 U.S. version.

vitolas.summary_review: Blind Man's Puff scored this Good (89/100), with a flavor arc from black tea/spice/honey through peppery earth to dark bitter chocolate and black licorice.

critic_reviews.key_notes_text: Good (89/100); Nicaraguan Habano wrapper/binder/filler; appearance 91, aroma 91, draw 90, burn 93, construction 89.

research_notes: CONFIRMED SEPARATE BLEND from plain Rosalones - Cigar Aficionado and halfwheel both explicitly describe them as two different blends: Reserva uses Nicaraguan Habano Criollo Colorado wrapper over Nicaraguan binder/filler (medium-bodied), while standard Rosalones (CT) uses Ecuador Connecticut-seed wrapper (milder). Only one photo exists in our library for this line specifically (JDN_Rosalones-Reserva_01.png), mixed into the general Rosalones folder rather than its own subfolder - see image manifest.
